page: Every child deserves a wonderful life. Explore Pinnacle's developmental pathway, licences, reported scale and source records. See what each document supports.
md5: PinnacleAI®'s MD-5 intended use names parents, therapists, educators and caregivers supporting children aged 0-12. Explore the non-diagnostic Class B device scope.
md3: Understand the documents behind PinnacleAI®: MD-3 is an application; MD-5 is the issued manufacturing licence. Read the originals, review conclusions and intended-use scope.
bis: Pinnacle's BIS schedule names software modules for the full developmental lifecycle of children. Read the quality-system scope alongside the MD-5 intended use.
hfr: Explore 56 complete HFR IDs matched in the NHPR dashboard on 19 September 2026: 33 Approved, with other workflow statuses and one masked Draft shown separately. Read every status and source.
external-validation: Good evidence starts with a clear study status. Explore Pinnacle's AbilityScore external-validation protocol, its planned methods and what results are still needed.
scale-data: Pinnacle reports 2.7 billion+ structured developmental records at 17 July 2026. Explore the counting definition and evidence; record volume is not a clinical-outcome measure.
scale-services: Pinnacle reports 31 million+ services at 17 July 2026, including assessments, screenings and parent training. See the counting criteria and practitioner reports.
scale-techniques: Pinnacle's management reports a repository of 130,000 early-intervention techniques. The updated inventory has not been inspected. Read the source history and scope.
scale-families: Pinnacle reports 792,614 beneficiary/family registrations at 17 July 2026 under stated criteria. Read the evidence and what this registration count measures.
scale-countries: Pinnacle reports families from 70+ countries, including remote delivery. This is family-origin reach, not 70+ countries with physical centres. Explore the source.
scale-centres: Pinnacle reports a 70+ centre network. Operational counts and HFR IDs are distinct measures; explore the centre inventory and dated evidence.
care: What can my child do now, and what support comes next? Explore Pinnacle's seven-stage pathway: measurement, planning, therapy, home practice, tracking, reassessment and growing independence.
pinnacle-profile: Measurement, a connected plan and support for everyday life: explore Pinnacle Blooms Network's documented approach and the sources behind it. Individual outcomes vary.
how-pinnacleai-works: How do observations become a child-specific plan? Explore how PinnacleAI® connects AbilityScore®, everyday practice, family feedback and human review—with links to the supporting documents.
feedback-changes-plan: What happens when an activity is too hard? Pinnacle describes feedback informing programme adjustments, with human oversight. Read the documented workflow and sources.
scale-for-every-child: Explore the scale behind PinnacleAI®: current figures, counting methods, independent report findings and a mission to empower children and families. See the evidence behind each number.
